notes: Gates with no open hours typed are open 07:00–17:00, the default gate hours (Config → Planning). Type a gate's own hours and shut times on its gate, under Data → Locations.
limits: Planning view, not a record of what happened.
Congestion on the public road is not modelled: each route has one drive time all day, so the only bottlenecks shown are at the gates and on site.
A lorry held up at a gate is not late for anything afterwards: each arrival is placed by its gate's open hours, not by the lorry's last trip.
